modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: Executable bootstrap: loads environment settings, initializes the order schema, and reports readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and translates environment variables into runtime configuration.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the in-memory Order data model.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite-backed persistence for order schema creation, inserts, and lookups.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds order event dictionaries; it does not write an audit store.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Binds HTTP POST and GET paths to order handlers.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Transforms request payloads, delegates persistence, and shapes create/read responses.

key_functions.description: Loads settings, constructs OrderRepository, initializes the schema, prints readiness, and returns 0.
Reads MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY, defaulting to orders.sqlite and false.
Creates the orders table if absent.
Inserts one Order into SQLite; duplicate IDs or database errors propagate.
Fetches one order by ID and reconstructs an Order, or returns None.
Registers POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> callbacks on the supplied app.
Builds an Order from required payload keys, converts total_cents to int, saves it once, and returns a created response with a generated event.
Looks up an order and returns either missing or its serialized fields plus a generated read event.
Creates an order event dictionary for a supplied action; it has no persistence side effect.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: The minisvc console script invokes minisvc.cli:main.
load_settings reads MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY into Settings.
main calls init_schema, which creates the SQLite orders table if needed.
main prints readiness and returns 0; it does not start an HTTP server.

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents and converts total_cents to int.
create_order calls repo.save once, inserting the order into SQLite.
create_order calls order_event(order, "created") and returns the status, ID, and event dictionary.
